verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no self-hostable sync server that keeps every secret inside the customer's perimeter. 1Password Connect Servers only provide private REST API access to 1Password items and vaults for your apps and infrastructure, which is an adjacent capability, not a self-hosted replacement for 1Password's sync backend. Community comments also note the loss of local vault storage.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter

citations.quote: 1Password Connect Servers allow you to securely access your 1Password items and vaults in your company's apps and cloud infrastructure using a private REST API.
